prompt: A clean side-view illustration of a science demo: a straight wooden dowel is dipped into a rectangular GLASS AQUARIUM half-full of water, seen from the side. Draw a bright red dashed vertical reference line straight down through where the dowel enters. Obey double refraction: where the dowel crosses the thick GLASS WALL band its apparent segment is displaced to the RIGHT of the red line, and where it continues into the WATER below its apparent segment is displaced to the LEFT of the red line -- the two displacements are on OPPOSITE sides. The top (air) part stays on the line. No text.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a straight rod dipped through the glass and water of a fish tank, with a red vertical guide line? Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel printing an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.
